name: Závod (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Závod (a blue shield with a yellow cross and a bunch of grapes, between ears of grain) above a yellow scroll inscribed ZÁVOD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Závod arms with grain and scroll
